slides.label: What it is
slides.title:
Three signs
in a row
body: Saturn spends about two and a half years in each sign
Sade Sati is when it crosses the sign before your Moon, your Moon sign, and the one after

items: The middle and heaviest part, until June 2027

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: What gets tested
items: Kept out of fear, it finally stops working
Late nights and skipped meals start sending the bill
Running on autopilot, it now needs real attention

slides.label: Sutra
slides.quote:
Saturn takes away what you
were only holding out of habit

slides.label: What Saturn rewards
slides.title: Built to last
items: The boring work done every week
Elders, and the people who work for you

slides.label: Practical remedy
slides.title:
One hour
every Saturday
body: List three things you do only out of habit
Every Saturday, one hour on what you keep putting off
